name: VM Killswitch
author: artemisa81
description: Cut internet access to dockur/windows VMs from the Omarchy bar, and hold them offline unless the IVPN tunnel is up and sealed.

barWidget.description: Block or allow the Windows VMs' internet, with a fail-closed require-VPN policy and LAN isolation.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget reconciles the rules and re-reads state. Each tick costs one `ivpn status` and one `docker exec` per running VM, so short intervals are not free.

schema.label: Notify on state change
schema.description: Send a desktop notification whenever the VMs are cut off or let back on. Worth leaving on: the require-VPN policy can re-block on its own, and a silent change is one you will not go looking for.

schema.label: Show dropped-packet counts
schema.description: Display how many packets each VM's block has eaten. Live evidence the rule is actually loaded rather than merely configured.
